input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
task: research/verified-dse milestone 140: run milestone 138's 15 unrun designs (run.py --resume) and analyse them as a pre-registered descriptive addition

errors.what: started fetch_pdk.sh and nix build as & subshells inside one background command; the parent exited, a stray copy raced the rerun and fetch_pdk.sh failed with 'unable to write new index file'
errors.fix: reran each as its own run_in_background command; the PDK fetch then took under a minute

doc_friction.issue: Reproduce block says fetch_pdk.sh and nix build but not that run.py --resume appends to the earlier milestone's results.jsonl, which would change that milestone's prefix-rule analysed set and break its test; I had to move the new rows out by hand

milestone 138 measured about 25 points a minute; the resumed designs ran 12 to 20 a minute (about 95 min for 1,774 points), close to the 2 h background limit; per-design throughput varies a lot with routed/r2

deviations.why: changed the print precision of prediction (4)'s p-value (4 to 6 decimals) after the flow ran, because it printed 0.0000
deviations.did: recorded the post-registration change in LOG.md; no rule, threshold or set changed

deviations.why: pdflatex is absent and its install takes about 10 min
deviations.did: regenerated main.tex with pandoc, left main.pdf at the milestone 139 build
deviations.result: main.pdf lags PAPER.md by one milestone

notes: All seven predictions held. 15 new designs: SWC 2.23% against random 6.25%, 13 better, 2 worse (sign p 0.0074). Milestone 138's full 40: 34 to 6 (p 0.000008). 73 blind designs pooled: 55 to 15, design-level mean -2.79 points, 95% interval -3.98 to -1.59. Checks run here: tests test_ladder_rest, test_ladder_confirm2, test_tight_theta, test_ladder_confirm (14 passed); research/_homepage/build.py ok; research_live_links ok; check_md_links ok; post front matter, links and similarity ok. Flow: OpenROAD 26Q3, Yosys 0.70 (nixpkgs), 1,774 points, 255 ABC failures.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: an EDA researcher setting up the flow, babysitting a 95-minute run, analysis and write-up

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
